translations.web: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
translations.bsb: Now about food sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
translations.kjv: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.
translations.asv: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but love edifieth.
